⚙ SETTINGS

Low quality turns off shadows, reduces particles and resolution — best for phones and older laptops.

⌨ CONTROLS

WASD / ArrowsMove
MouseLook (click the game to lock the mouse)
ShiftSprint (loud)
C / CtrlCrouch (quieter, harder to see). Crouch beside a wall to wall-hug.
SpaceJump · climb ledges · vault obstacles
EInteract: steal, takedown, hide in closets, crawl vents
Q / Right mouse (hold)Aim Shadow Step — release to teleport into a dark spot
FShadow Clone — a decoy that pulls guards' attention
R / Left mouseThrowing star — breaks lights, stuns guards (auto-targets near the crosshair)
GDistraction throw — makes a noise where you aim
XShadow Pulse — snuffs nearby lights for a while
VSmoke bomb (upgrade)
ZShadow Meld — in deep shadow, dissolve into the dark: unseen even up close, slow, drains energy. Light, actions or running dry pull you out. Dogs, Elite Hunter bursts and shadow-seeing Legends can still find you.
Esc / PPause
TouchLeft stick moves, drag the right side to look. STEP: tap to aim, tap again to teleport.
